description: This file defines API endpoints for managing user's favorite recipes using FastAPI. It includes routes to add and remove favorites, interacts with SQLAlchemy models and database sessions, and enforces user authentication.

methods.name: add_favorite( recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(db_session), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user), )
methods.description: Adds a recipe to the current user's favorites if it exists; idempotent operation.

methods.name: remove_favorite( recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(db_session), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user), )
methods.description: Removes a recipe from the current user's favorites if it exists.

ctags.name: add_favorite
ctags.signature: ( recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(db_session), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user), )

ctags.signature: ( recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(db_session), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user), )
